elements.name: decode_rgb
elements.brief: Decodes a valid PNG into an RGB buffer with one uint8 `pixels` stream of
elements.description:
Decodes a valid PNG into an RGB buffer with one uint8 `pixels` stream of
three components per pixel. The decoded rows are flipped vertically to
match Defold's buffer orientation. The extension ignores LodePNG's decode
error, so a corrupt PNG may crash the engine instead of returning nils.
Three nils mean the buffer could not be created or failed validation, so
check the buffer before reading the dimensions.

parameters.name: png
parameters.doc: The PNG bytes, which must be a valid PNG.

parameters.name: premultiply_alpha
parameters.doc:
Accepted for symmetry with
{@link png.decode_rgba}; it only has effect in the RGBA path.

returnvalues.doc:
The pixel buffer, its width and its height, or three nils when
the buffer cannot be created or fails validation.
types: LuaMultiReturn<[ Opaque<"buffer"> & { length: LuaLengthMethod<number>; }, number, number ] | [ undefined, undefined, undefined ]>

elements.name: decode_rgba
elements.brief: Decodes a valid PNG into an RGBA buffer with one uint8 `pixels` stream of
elements.description:
Decodes a valid PNG into an RGBA buffer with one uint8 `pixels` stream of
four components per pixel. The decoded rows are flipped vertically to
match Defold's buffer orientation. The extension ignores LodePNG's decode
error, so a corrupt PNG may crash the engine instead of returning nils.
Three nils mean the buffer could not be created or failed validation, so
check the buffer before reading the dimensions.

parameters.name: png
parameters.doc: The PNG bytes, which must be a valid PNG.

parameters.name: premultiply_alpha
parameters.doc:
Multiply each pixel's color components by its
alpha while decoding.

returnvalues.doc:
The pixel buffer, its width and its height, or three nils when
the buffer cannot be created or fails validation.
types: LuaMultiReturn<[ Opaque<"buffer"> & { length: LuaLengthMethod<number>; }, number, number ] | [ undefined, undefined, undefined ]>

elements.name: info
elements.brief: Reads the header of PNG bytes without decoding the pixels.
elements.description: Reads the header of PNG bytes without decoding the pixels.

returnvalues.doc:
The image's dimensions, its LodePNG color type ({@link png.RGBA},
{@link png.RGB}, {@link png.GREY}, {@link png.GREY_ALPHA} or
{@link png.PALETTE}) and its bit depth.
types: { width: number; height: number; colortype: number; bitdepth: number; }
